payload.title: Review Brief: Operations Board Runtime Integration
payload.summary: Codex PR #4 has been merged into main. I reviewed the actual changed files and implementation, not just the screenshot. The delivery appears to satisfy the requested Operations Board runtime integration package at the implementation level.
payload.review_subject: PR #4 — Implement Operations Board runtime integration
implementation_summary: Added src/estate/core/operations_board.py as the runtime aggregation module.
Added operations-board CLI command in src/estate/cli/main.py with --json support.
ca3_findings: The implementation preserves architecture by declaring the board an operational view generated from existing artifacts, not a new governance source of truth.
The aggregator consumes collaboration status, routing, worker inboxes, audit artifacts, and registry files where present.
Missing optional artifacts are recorded as warnings rather than fatal errors.
Malformed JSON is recorded as a warning and skipped rather than crashing generation.
Capability lifecycle states are checked against the Estate lifecycle set: Designed, Implemented, Operationally Validated, Institutionalized.
Tests cover full sample artifact generation, missing artifacts, malformed JSON, Markdown generation, and CLI registration.
lifecycle_assessment: Operations Board Runtime Integration should be treated as Implemented.
Operational validation has started but should not be considered complete until the board is run against the live local Estate state after pull and reviewed by CA2/CA3/Steward.
requested_ca2_review: Confirm whether the generated board sections are sufficient for WP-0005 closeout.
Review whether Status: Operationally Validated in docs/operations/Operations_Board_Runtime_Integration.md is premature before local live-state validation.
Determine whether the output path operations/board/latest.md is acceptable as a generated operational artifact.
Recommend whether Codex should adjust any wording to avoid implying governance authority.
recommended_next_validation: Review warnings for missing or malformed artifacts.
Decide whether the capability remains Implemented or can advance toward Operationally Validated after real-use review.
